name: Philip of Jesus
contribution: A New Spanish Franciscan missionary who became one of the Twenty-six Martyrs of Japan.

checks.lead: Philip of Jesus, OFM (Spanish: Felipe de Jesús; 1572 – 1597) was a New Spanish Franciscan missionary who became one of the Twenty-six Martyrs of Japan. He is the first Mexican Catholic saint and is the patron saint of Mexico City.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
